p1.text: You are an apprentice word wizard. In your world, a word said with meaning is a spell.

p2.text: Tonight you stand in an old courtyard in Saint Petersburg, Russia. The lamps are dark.

p3.text: A curse called the Silence has stolen this courtyard's words. Where the words went, everything froze.

p4.text: Learn Russian words from the people here. Cast them as spells to wake the courtyard, and open the gate to the city.

p5.text: Meet Eeskra, a spark of living language. She will be your guide.

note: 2026-11-15 lane J: trimmed at sentence pauses (p2 keeps sentences 1-2, p5 starts at Meet Iskra) and sped 1.15x with ffmpeg atempo (pitch kept), offline, no paid API. Originals: .tmp/lingolens/ll/J/orig_prologue. Re-running render_prologue_voices.py --force restores the long takes.
